title: array

messages.description: output a pointer to the scalar containing the array
a pointer to the scalar containing the array at bangs

arguments.description: function of [array]: define, size, sum, get, set, quantile, random, max or min

methods.description: send pointer to a named receive object

body: [array] creates or accesses an array of numbers. Its first argument selects the function: [array define] creates one, and [array size], [array sum], [array get], [array set], [array quantile], [array random], [array max] and [array min] work on an array defined elsewhere. Without an argument it is [array define].
